title: Press Operation Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Press Operation Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
html:
Project Information

JSA ID: PRESS-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PRESS TYPE: ☐ Mechanical ☐ Hydraulic ☐ Pneumatic TONNAGE: ______________ tons

DIE #: ______________ SETUP PERSON: ______________ OPERATOR: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Die Setup & Adjustment-Crush points
-Heavy dies
-Pinch points
-Improper clamping		-Amputation
-Crush injuries
-Die ejection		25 (VERY HIGH)-Use die setting blocks
-LOTO during setup
-Use die lifters/carts
-Check die height and parallelism
-Verify die clamping secure
2. Safeguarding Check-Missing guards
-Bypassed devices
-Malfunctioning		-Hand/finger amputation
-Crush injuries		25 (VERY HIGH)-Verify presence sensing devices
-Test light curtains
-Check two-hand controls
-Verify pullbacks/restraints
-Test brake performance
3. Production Operation-Hand in die area
-Part ejection
-Repeat motion injury		-Amputation
-Severe lacerations
-Eye injury
-CTD		20 (VERY HIGH)-Never bypass safeguards
-Use feeding tools
-Keep hands clear of point of operation
-Monitor part ejection
-Maintain proper pace
4. Die Clearing (Jams)-Crush points
-Stored energy
-Unexpected cycling		-Crush injuries
-Amputation		16 (HIGH)-LOTO before clearing
-Use clearing tools
-Release all stored energy
-Block or pin the ram
5. Die Change & Storage-Falling dies
-Struck by crane/hoist
-Improper storage		-Crush
-Fractures
-Struck by loads		15 (HIGH)-Use die storage racks properly
-Secure dies during transport
-Mark die weight on die
-Store heavy dies on lower shelves
-Keep aisles clear

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ Face Shield ☐ Hearing Protection ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves

☐ Arm guards ☐ Apron
